name: WIW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Created by a 20-man over-the-top battle royal at the promotion's first-ever broadcast, named its top prize by the promotion's own founding post.

name: WIW International Championship
epitaph: Billed as the promotion's second most prestigious title; its first challengers were drawn from a bucket on the promotion's first-ever broadcast.

name: WIW Superpro Championship
epitaph: Billed as a title for wrestlers willing to put it all on the line; its first challengers were drawn from a bucket on the promotion's first-ever broadcast.

name: WIW World Television Championship
epitaph: Billed as the promotion's working man's title, defended almost every card; its first challengers were drawn from a bucket on the promotion's first-ever broadcast.

name: WIW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Created by an eight-team tournament at the promotion's first-ever broadcast, its final unresolved when the broadcast ended.
